text: New HS code notes for wooden furniture parts take effect on 1 December. Under the notes, flat-pack parts shipped separately from the finished furniture (legs, frames, panels) are classified under the heading for furniture parts, not under the heading for worked wood. The duty rate in most destination markets is the same, but the change affects certificates of origin, because the product description must match the new heading. Exporters who ship parts on their own should update the HS code in their commercial invoice, packing list and certificate application before the first December shipment. Ask your customs broker to confirm the code for each item if your parts differ from these examples.
